parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive messaging group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-message-group-band --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveMessageGroupBand --region cn-hangzhou --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest
